summary: Zevia PBC's subsidiary entered into a First Amendment to its existing Loan and Security Agreement with Bank of America. The amendment extends the maturity to 2027, reduces the credit spread adjustment to 0.10%, and modifies financial covenants including a minimum liquidity of $7M and a fixed charge coverage ratio of 1.00x under certain conditions. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation event. The filing is an 8-K disclosing entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special-situation category applies.
